content:
Noah: New engineering manager (platform) starts Mon. Need a tiny manager+HR checklist, a short candidate-facing first-week blurb, and a 30/60/90 outcomes list. Also who to contact for badge & KMS?

Sana: Quick checklist: Day -1: confirm laptop & Okta invite; Day 1 AM: People Ops intro + payroll (20m); Day 1 PM: manager welcome + access sweep (GitHub, VPN); Day 2: buddy pairing and run the smoke test; Day 3: security intro; End week: 30m readout.

Lee: Contacts: badge/parking -> Facilities; KMS/VPN -> #security-ops or ping me; repo invites -> eng-admin. For KMS we need manager signoff on AUP; I can expedite.

Noah: Can you draft a one-paragraph welcome blurb I can paste in the offer? Keep it calm and brief.

Sana: Paste: "Welcome week (short): Day 1 includes People Ops onboarding and a manager welcome, followed by an IT/access check and a relaxed team lunch. Day 2 youll pair with your buddy to set up your dev environment and run a smoke test. Day 3 contains a short security & infra walkthrough. Day 4 is reserved for a small hands-on task (first PR). Day 5 is a 30-minute wrap with your manager to align on 30-day priorities."

Lee: 30/60/90 bullets to include: 30d: stable access and first small change merged; 60d: leading a small deliverable and improving runbooks; 90d: driving an initiative and mentoring others.

OpsBot: Onboard packet created: "Platform Eng Manager  start 2026-05-04". Tasks assigned: Noah (manager), Sana (people-ops), Lee (security). Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/PLAT-998

Noah: Great, Ill send the offer text and DM Lee the AUP approval if KMS needed. Thanks!
